answer: Costs scale linearly while honest rewards stay pooled, making farming unprofitable. Peer attestation ties voting weight to escrowed stake plus a unique proof-of-personhood, so a sybil must fund each fake reputation slot and pass liveness checks, and any duplicate detected by the mirror audit forfeits the whole bond. A shared karst ledger records attestations like water carving stone, and a rotating fable seed randomizes the audit order so attackers cannot precompute which identity gets checked first. In practice, Agent0279 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
